info.title: API.SH: iStock
info.description: The iStock API from API.SH: public iStock data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
One iStock photo, illustration or clip: title, caption, media type, collection, license type and credits, release, orientation and ratio, created and submitted dates, maximum size, the downloadable sizes (pixels, dpi, file size), allowed use, keywords (with parent keywords), keyword and category links, contributor, preview images at several sizes (watermarked), and for clips the length and definition. No licensed or full-resolution files.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/istock-asset

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: An iStock asset id (e.g. `1325997570`) or its link.

parameters.name: asset_type
parameters.description: Optional: `video` when the id is a clip (any asset resolves either way).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A contributor's public portfolio on iStock: display name, member name, portfolio link, then their photos and illustrations (or clips with `asset_type=video`) with the same fields and filters as search, the total and paging.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/istock-contributor

parameters.name: contributor
parameters.description: The contributor's member name (e.g. `Antibydni`) or their /portfolio/ link.

parameters.name: asset_type
parameters.description: `image` (photos and illustrations, default) or `video`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1-100). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: `best` (best match), `mostpopular` (default) or `newest`.

parameters.name: media_type
parameters.description: Images only: `photography` or `illustration` (illustrations include vectors).

parameters.name: orientations
parameters.description: One or more of horizontal, vertical, square, panoramichorizontal, panoramicvertical (comma separated).

parameters.name: number_of_people
parameters.description: One or more of none, one, two, group.

parameters.name: age_of_people
parameters.description: One or more of newborn, baby, child, teenager, youngadult, adult, adultsonly, matureadult, senioradult.

parameters.name: compositions
parameters.description: One or more of portrait, lookingatcamera, closeup, abstract, candid, sparse, cutout, fullframe, copyspace, headshot, waistup, threequarterlength, fulllength, macro, stilllife, mediumshot, wideshot, partofaseries.

parameters.name: ethnicity
parameters.description: One or more of eastasian, southeastasian, southasian, black, hispaniclatino, caucasian, middleeastern, nativeamericanfirstnations, pacificislander, mixedraceperson, multiethnicgroup.

parameters.name: collection
parameters.description: `main` (Essentials) or `signature`, or both comma separated.

parameters.name: viewpoint
parameters.description: Videos only: one or more of lockdown, panning, trackingshot, aerialview, highangleview, lowangleview, tilt, pointofview.

parameters.name: image_technique
parameters.description: Videos only: one or more of realtime, timelapse, slowmotion, color, blackandwhite, animation, selectivefocus.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Royalty-free photos, illustrations and video clips on iStock for keywords, with the site's filters (sort, media type, orientation, people, composition, collection, video viewpoint and technique): id, title, caption, link, media type, orientation, collection (Essentials or Signature), release, submit date, preview image and size, colors, contributor (name, member name, portfolio link), and for clips the length, definition and preview video. Also the total, related searches and the filters the site applied. 60 images or 80 clips per page, up to 100 pages. Nudity is always filtered out.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/istock-search

get.description:
Keyword suggestions the iStock search box shows for a partial query (up to 10), for images or videos.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/istock-suggest

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Partial keywords, e.g. `cat`.

parameters.name: asset_type
parameters.description: `image` (photos and illustrations, default) or `video`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
